ios.desc:
The Dancing Dog app uses AI to turn your dog’s photo into a 10-second dance video!
It’s simple and fur-tastic:

1. Snap a picture of your dog

2. Use a 'Treat' to generate a unique dancing video
(Treats are available via in-app purchase)

3. Share it with your pack

Each video is generated by AI – based on your photo – and features one of 10 dance styles, from Salsa and Ballet to the classic Robot dance. Who knew your pup had such groovy moves?

All the dogs in the video belong to friends – starring in chronological order:
Apollo
Soda
Murray
Mila
Lilly
Remy
Alabama
Mitch
Bella
Opi
Kabosu
Jen
Marley

Thank you so much for the support! 

wooF wooF
